notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for negotiated Willing-to-Acquire continuation after the first candidate cancels. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ ownership APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. Evoked delivery preserves two If Available reservations, verifies unpublishing is rejected while the first candidate is in Willing to Acquire, and continues to the next candidate after cancellation. It also verifies the If Available tag reaches Request Divestiture Confirmation and the Confirm Divestiture tag reaches the resulting Attribute Ownership Acquisition Notification. Immediate delivery verifies the standard unavailable boundary and uses regular Acquisition Pending for continuation. These callback-model assertions share one public-API body and are not independent or conformance evidence.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, confirmDivestiture, and unpublishObjectClassAttributes with standard ownership callbacks
